title: FounderGate role floor control plane (m1 and m4 host profiles)
description: Schemas for the disk-backed control plane of the FounderGate role floor. One implementation serves both host profiles; the role and artifact authority tables come from config/hosts/<host>.json. Mutable documents are replaced atomically; the event log is append-only and hash-chained.

role.description: The last three exist only on the m4 profile.

artifact_class.description: A class is writable only by the roles the loaded host profile names, and only when the profile does not seal it. On m1 the integration, verification and merge classes are sealed outright; on m4 the signature, activation and deployment classes are sealed.

digest.description: KEYED seal: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical record with the digest field removed, under the per-run writer secret at control/.writer_secret. Recomputing it requires that secret, so the party the lease constrains can no longer push out its own expiry or rewrite writer_role and re-seal. NOT a defence against an actor who can read the writer secret; on one macOS user account, that is any process the founder runs.

role_result.description: Every role result is bound to run, task, role identity, candidate identity, prompt digest, session identity, launch nonce and event-chain position, and carries a KEYED artifact MAC. A result written through the wrong role writer is rejected by the artifact-class table before any credential is examined. Every consuming gate re-verifies the MAC and the embedded run_id/task_id IMMEDIATELY before it decides, so a payload swapped after an earlier check is not used. NOT a defence against a same-user process that can read control/.writer_secret.

artifact_mac.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical artifact with artifact_mac removed, keyed with the per-run writer secret.

launch_nonce.description: The launch nonce of the single-use capability that authorised this write.

event.description: Append-only. Each line carries a KEYED digest (HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical line body under the per-run writer secret) and commits to its predecessor's digest; the first line's prev_digest is the literal GENESIS. The chain's LENGTH and HEAD are committed separately in control/EVENTS.anchor.json and, when a witness directory exists, in an append-only witness outside the run root. That combination detects in-place edits, insertions, deletions, TAIL TRUNCATION and wholesale rewrites: a valid prefix is no longer a valid chain. HONEST SCOPE: an actor who reads control/.writer_secret can recompute line digests and re-anchor; the witness records conflicting heads at the same length, which makes such a rewrite visible but does not prevent it. This is not an independent notary.

digest.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical line body (digest field removed), keyed with the per-run writer secret.

handoff.description: Mechanical basis for restarting the SAME role in a fresh context.

retry_state.description: context_restarts and correction_attempts are counted separately: a context restart never consumes a correction attempt.

host_profile.description: config/hosts/<host>.json. A host is configuration, not a fork.

authorities.description: production_deployment, activation_consumption and founder_signature_execution are refused even when a profile sets them true.

founder_receipt.description: A detached SSHSIG signature over the receipt's canonical body, produced by an Ed25519 PRIVATE key that exists only on founder-controlled hardware. This package holds the PUBLIC key only, pinned by SHA-256 fingerprint in the digest-covered host profile, and contains NO signing verb: grep -rn -- '-Y sign' over bin/ and lib/ returns nothing, and both selftests assert it. Verify and forge are no longer the same operation. CANONICAL BODY (the exact signed bytes): jq -S -c 'del(.signature)' receipt.json > body. SIGN: ssh-keygen -Y sign -f <founder private key> -n foundergate.founder-receipt.v2 body. The key set must be EXACTLY the required fields plus 'signature', in sorted order, with no duplicates and nothing extra; anything else is FOUNDER_RECEIPT_MALFORMED before any cryptography runs. A receipt is spent exactly once. Verification performs no git operation.

action.description: The gated action this approval is for, e.g. 'merge'. A receipt for one action never authorises another.

nonce.description: Unique per receipt. Spent once; recorded in CONSUMED_RECEIPTS.json and in the keyed event chain.

signer_fingerprint.description: SHA256:... of the founder PUBLIC key. Must equal the pin in the loaded host profile.

verification_report_digest.description: report_digest of the final_verification_report this approval was issued against.

signature.description: Armored detached SSHSIG over the canonical body, namespace foundergate.founder-receipt.v2.

final_verification_report.description: Bound to the exact final SHA and tree. A moved SHA is refused rather than re-verified.

role_capability.description: On-disk COMMITMENT to a per-launch, single-use role capability. The capability itself is 32 random bytes, delivered to the launched process once over a mode-0600 FIFO that is unlinked on first read, and is NEVER written to any file. This record contains only cap_commit, from which the capability cannot be recovered; presenting cap_commit confers nothing. Issuing a new capability for the same (task, role) invalidates the previous one. HONEST SCOPE: once delivered the capability lives in the launched process's environment, readable by another process running as the same user, and any same-user process can call the issuing function itself. Issuance is recorded in the keyed event chain naming the issuing pid, so ad-hoc issuance is DETECTABLE, not prevented.

cap_commit.description: HMAC-SHA256(per-run writer secret, canonical binding | capability).

event_anchor.description: control/EVENTS.anchor.json. Commits the chain's length and head so a truncated tail is no longer a valid chain (F-H02). Mirrored, when a witness directory exists, to an append-only witness file outside the run root.

seal.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical anchor with seal removed, keyed with the per-run writer secret.

consumed_receipts.description: control/CONSUMED_RECEIPTS.json. Durable one-time-use ledger for founder decision receipt nonces, kept in agreement with founder_receipt_consumed events in the keyed chain. A MISSING or UNREADABLE ledger is a REFUSAL (FOUNDER_RECEIPT_LEDGER_CONSUMED_LEDGER_MISSING), never an optimistic 'nothing consumed yet': deleting it does not re-enable a spent receipt.

seal.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical ledger with seal removed, keyed with the per-run writer secret.

host_enrollment.description: EXTERNAL record, never written by this package, binding a host profile to a physical machine. Required for any profile carrying integration authority; the requirement is derived from the authority set, not from a profile boolean. Signed with the enrollment authority PRIVATE key on founder hardware; this package holds only the public half, pinned by fingerprint. CANONICAL BODY: jq -S -c . enrollment.json. NAMESPACE: foundergate.host-enrollment.v1. A --host argument is profile selection, NOT attestation.

platform_uuid.description: IOPlatformUUID, read read-only via ioreg and compared, never invented.
